_about: Demo cases verified by hand in the raw wikitext (dates in UTC). Finnish quotes are exact excerpts; English lines are the team's translations. No account names.

cases.after_en: Passage deleted with 10 references, under the edit summary "Korjauksia, faktapohjaisuus" (corrections, fact-based).
